__comment: Live streams from Owncast (owncast.online), self-hosted live streaming, in Videos: one server by its address, or the Owncast Directory (directory.owncast.online) of the servers that are live now. The customUI app org.webosports.app.videoauth asks which, and calls org.webosports.service.videos/login with this templateId, which checks the server (/api/config, /api/status) or reads the directory before Accounts stores the account. Nothing is signed in to.
__comment2: org.webosports.app.videoauth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs as the customUI app. org.webosports.service.videos reads the credentials for every catalogue call.
